newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Crash of helicopters the worst in Israeli history.
newsitem.headline: Crash of helicopters the worst in Israeli history.

text.p: The mid-air collision of two air-force helicopters on Tuesday was the worst military aviation disaster in the nearly 50 years of Israeli history.
Here is a list of some of the other air disasters, provided by the Israeli army:
- May 1977: Sikorsky helicopter crashes, killing 54 Israeli paratroopers.
- April 22, 1990: Two Sikorsky helicopters crash during an exercise, killing seven soldiers.
- December 13, 1990: Cessna plane crashes while on transport mission in southern Israel, killing five soldiers.
- January 12, 1994: Helicopter crashes after hitting antenna while trying to land, killing the central area army commander Major-General Nehemia Tamari and three other officers.
- March 31, 1996: Sikorsky helicopter crashes soon after takeoff in the Judean desert, killing seven soldiers.
- February 4, 1997: Two Sikorsky CH-53 transporters collide in mid-air in northern Israel on way to southern Lebanon, killing at least 70 soldiers.
